title: Best drummers for steady time and the Barbarin brothers
summary: Asked for the steadiest rhythm men, he praises the Barbarin drummers; brief chat about ages and birthdays.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who were the best musicians for good steady time? The best rhythm man, you know, for steady

time then? Well, I played with so many good drummers, man. Yeah. Boy, they got the little boy, you know Bobberin. Oh, yeah. Yeah, that was the one. That was the Sydney band. Boy, that was a hell of a drummer. Louie or Paul, or? Louie. Louie, yeah. The brothers have a drummer too. Yeah. Bobberin, Paul.
Well, Louie still sounds good, you know. He sounds like a professional drummer to me.
He is, boy. I was young, boy, he's hell. When he was young, boy, I was a little bit of a boy. I'm a big up in my ears, man. Yeah. Who do you think I am?
Uh, about sixteen. Huh? About sixteen. Shit.

Well, it's a long time ago, like a couple of years, like you said, sixteen. Never see that no more. I never see that no more. Well, what's your birthday? Huh? What's your birthday? I forgot what your birthday was. March 26th. March 26th.
